title: Price Drop Alert
content: Build price drop alert feature. Trigger: "Notify me when price drops" link/button on product page. Modal form: email input, optional target price ("Alert me when below $X"), current price display. Confirmation: success message with check, email sent. Management: link to manage all alerts. Badge on product: show if user has active alert. Integration: appears when product viewed but not purchased.

variants.simple: Create price drop notification signup form.
variants.detailed: Build price drop alert feature. Trigger: "Notify me when price drops" link/button on product page. Modal form: email input, optional target price ("Alert me when below $X"), current price display. Confirmation: success message with check, email sent. Management: link to manage all alerts. Badge on product: show if user has active alert. Integration: appears when product viewed but not purchased.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive price drop alert system with signup flow and management. Trigger placement: on product page near price, text link "Get Price Drop Alert" or "Notify me when price drops" with Bell icon, also appears in wishlist items. Trigger states: default state for new signup, "Alert Active" badge (bg-blue-100 text-blue-800) if user already subscribed, click to modify. Modal/drawer form: header "Price Drop Alert" with Bell icon. Current price display: "Current Price: $149.99" prominently shown. Email input: pre-filled if user logged in, placeholder "Enter your email", validation. Target price option: optional section "Alert me when price drops below:", input with currency symbol, slider alternative between current price and 50% off, presets: "Any drop", "10% off ($134.99)", "25% off ($112.49)". Frequency preference: "How often can we email you?" - Immediately, Daily digest, Weekly digest. Product info: small product image and name for confirmation of what they're tracking. Submit button: "Set Alert" or "Notify Me" primary button. Terms: small text "We'll email you when price drops. Unsubscribe anytime." Privacy link. Success confirmation: modal shows success check animation, "You'll be notified when [Product] drops below $[Target]", "Check your email for confirmation" note, "View All Alerts" link to management page. Already subscribed: if returning, show current alert settings, "Update Alert" and "Remove Alert" buttons. Alert management page: list of all active price alerts, each row shows product thumbnail, name, current price, target price, date created, status (Active, Triggered, Expired), actions to edit target or remove. Email template: professional email showing product dropped to $X, clear CTA to view product, one-click unsubscribe. Notification channels: email primary, optional SMS, push notification if app. Integration with wishlist: all wishlisted items show option to add price alert, bulk "Set alerts for all" option. Back-in-stock combo: for out-of-stock items, combine with stock alert. Analytics: track alert-to-purchase conversion. Rate limiting: limit number of alerts per user to prevent abuse. Accessibility: form properly labeled, success clearly announced, modal traps focus.
